observations.content: Debugging 202 empty-body responses: comparing raw fetch (gets 200) vs mcpCall body; both send same body, same Accept header, but EXT body at 12:45 sent with NO "id" field while raw sent {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,...}.

Root cause found: assistant's own Phase 1 rewrite of paseo-channel.ts accidentally dropped the JSON-RPC "id":1 field from the tools/call body; per JSON-RPC 2.0 an id-less request is a notification, so the daemon processes it but never replies and Express returns 202 with empty body.
The Paseo daemon restart was a red herring; the 202 bug was introduced by the assistant's own Phase 1 rewrite (old code had id:1 and worked that morning).
Both live (.pi/extensions) and dev (extensions) copies of paseo-channel.ts at lines 80-84 lacked the id field; grep confirmed both were identical and missing id.

Fixed mcpCall in /home/coder/workspaces/learn/extensions/subagent-types/paseo-channel.ts by adding incremental id via let callSeq = 0 and body id: ++callSeq, plus a code comment warning the id field is mandatory and must never be dropped.
Completed edit to dev paseo-channel.ts applied cleanly (1 block replaced).

After fix, bun test subagent-types ran 52 tests across 2 files, 0 fail, 87 expect() calls, 791ms; spawned probe via fixed extension returned {"ok":true,"agentId":"ee225b41-f056-4c68-af6e-06045184861d","status":"running"} confirming spawn works again.
Assistant noted its own pi process loaded extensions at 12:35 (before the fix), so its in-memory mcpCall still has the id-less bug; disk now has fixed code which new children load fresh.
First attempt to spawn asker via MCP gateway used tool name create_agent which does not exist; server paseo actually exposes paseo_create_agent (among 39+ paseo_ prefixed tools).
Spawned asker scout via paseo_create_agent with labels subagent.role=scout and subagent.parent=cf76ad71-3f82-4296-960f-fa9e2fcd06ee, agentId 906c451c-4785-40a7-bfa7-49ad12870de6, status running.

Asker's kind=ask message 'What is the secret word I must report?' landed in main's queue file ~/.pi/agent/subagent-channel/cf76ad71-*.jsonl after 5s and was also injected into main's context as <subagent-message> via the turn-boundary drain firing mid-run between LLM rounds.
Assistant pushed kind=reply entry directly into the child's queue file (bypassing its own broken in-memory message_subagent) with text 'The secret word is PINEAPPLE-42.'
Asker (906c451c) finished and reported exactly PINEAPPLE-42, closing the full ask_question E2E loop (ask to queue, drain injection, direct reply push, waitForReply absorb, report).
Completed: Phase 2 ask_question park/wait/absorb E2E verified with PINEAPPLE-42; kind=ask rendering verified (saw <subagent-message kind="ask"> in context).

Final sync verified via diff -q: paseo-channel.ts, index.ts, channel.test.ts, agents/researcher.md all sync dev==live; .pi/extensions/subagent-types/agents/ contains mermaid-maker.md, researcher.md, scout.md, svg-maker.md, worker.md (5 roles, learn-researcher gone).

Assistant reported remaining tasks: (1) its pi process still runs id-less mcpCall in memory for spawn_subagent/message_subagent until next session restart; (2) registry E2E pending new main session; (3) ~15 test/probe agents to archive; (4) update tests/TOOL-TEST-REPORT-2026-08-30.md.

User asked (in Vietnamese) whether Paseo needs restarting and what to do next; assistant confirmed restart once more is needed because its pi process loaded code at 12:35 with the in-memory 202 bug, and gave a checklist (user restarts, then messages to trigger registry E2E, optional archive/report).
User said they restarted Paseo and asked assistant to check.

After restart, spawned scout agent with name="registry-check", role=scout, task to call message_main with exact text REG-E2E-OK; spawned agent 345f36ad-7477-46ba-96b4-5c55cfa7725f running, id fix working (no 202).

Child's message_main REG-E2E-OK flowed into assistant's context mid-run via drain; registry.json confirmed entry registry-check -> agentId 345f36ad-7477-46ba-96b4-5c55cfa7725f, role scout, created 2026-08-30T13:10:09.492Z (registry write E2E verified).

message_subagent by name resolved registry-check (no agentId) to idle child, delivered and started new turn; child 345f36ad woke, processed, and stopped with 'Stopping.' — resume-by-name E2E verified.

Completed full Phase 1+2 E2E: file queue persistent + restart, turn-boundary pickup (mid-run and post-restart), ask_question absorb (PINEAPPLE-42), ask render kind=ask, name registry write/resolve/resume (registry-check), JSON-RPC id fix, system simplification 6 to 5 roles.

Two untested knobs remain: interrupt:true flag (same send path as resume) and ask_question wait_seconds park-timeout (unit tested, E2E park-timeout pending); assistant offered to archive ~16 test agents and update tests/TOOL-TEST-REPORT-2026-08-30.md.

User reported receiving the message 'Specify streamingBehavior (‘steer’ or ‘followUp’) to queue the message.' and asked whether this is normal (Vietnamese: 'Ủa là sao? Cái này có bình thường không?').
